text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Tender (RFT) for the Parking Lot 2 AODA (Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act) Compliance Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of Request For Tender (RFT) 56 for the Construction of Parking Lot 2 AODA Compliance to KP Construction up to a commitment of $900,000.00 including an allowance to dispose of contaminated soil as necessary.
